episode_summary: In this episode, Carrie McCormick discusses the evolving luxury real estate market, emphasizing the shift towards lifestyle optimization driven by AI wealth. She highlights the importance of personal branding and digital presence in standing out, and shares strategies for building relationships and crafting effective offers in a competitive market.
